enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element insects across the rightmost three columns, spread over all six lanes. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs discard the whole Construct instead. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element insects across the rightmost three columns, spread over all six lanes. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs discard the whole Construct instead. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element insects across the rightmost three columns, spread over all six lanes. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs discard the whole Construct instead. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

ideons.text: Moves one space west, northwest or southwest, randomly choosing a legal space and swapping any player Construct into its old space. At the left edge, strikes for 9 damage of its element and disappears.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element insects across the rightmost three columns, spread over all six lanes. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs discard the whole Construct instead. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element insects across the rightmost three columns, spread over all six lanes. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs discard the whole Construct instead. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element insects across the rightmost three columns, spread over all six lanes. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs discard the whole Construct instead. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element insects across the rightmost three columns, spread over all six lanes. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs discard the whole Construct instead. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element insects across the rightmost three columns, spread over all six lanes. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs discard the whole Construct instead. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element insects across the rightmost three columns, spread over all six lanes. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs discard the whole Construct instead. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element insects across the rightmost three columns, spread over all six lanes. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs discard the whole Construct instead. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element insects across the rightmost three columns, spread over all six lanes. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs discard the whole Construct instead. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.

enemies.name: The Mind Hive
enemies.signature: Invulnerable: survive 15 rounds. Starts with eight mixed-element insects across the rightmost three columns, spread over all six lanes. You act before they move. Each turn commands existing insects, hatches last turn's Mind Eggs, then lays new ones, including beneath cards. Rounds 1–4: 1 egg in the rightmost column; 5–8: 2 in the rightmost two; 9–11: 4 in the rightmost three; 12–13: 6 in the rightmost four; 14: 8 in the rightmost four. Round 15 commands and hatches, then dies. Eggs vary across all seven elements. Uncovered eggs deal 8 of their element; covered eggs discard the whole Construct instead. Both hatch an insect. Every fourth egg contains a stationary 50-HP Drone: attacks for 5, 10, 15 damage and so on. Burrowers move west; Skitters choose west, northwest or southwest. Both swap through player cards, moving leftmost first. Newborns first act on the following turn; all vanish when the Hive dies. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Cover eggs with expendable cards to recycle them, or remove eggs with Machine Elves. Prepare for mixed elements. Storm Canopy does not hit Ideons; use targeted attacks, Lucid Guide or Scouring Gale.
